meta.unit: fees in hundredths of a bip on a 1e6 scale: 10000 = 1 percent of the swapped amount
meta.classRule: PAYS-LPS per classify_book in docs/ops/v4_fee_screen.py — DEAD iff swaps_sampled == 0; HOOK-MONETIZED iff zero_fee_swaps*2 >= swaps_sampled and protocol_fees_nonzero; else PAYS-LPS. The class never reads initFee.
meta.labelRule: initFee is the fee label decoded from the pool's Initialize log (fixture field init_fee)
meta.measuredRule: feeWavg is the swap-count-weighted mean of fees charged on the sampled Swap logs (fixture field fee_wavg)
meta.divergenceRule: diverges == (initFee != feeWavg); counts.divergeOverHalf counts rows where abs(initFee - feeWavg) > feeWavg / 2
meta.maskRule: mask = the hook address's low 14 bits in hex; the literal 0x0 when the book has no hook
meta.aliasPolicy: pool ids only: no pool names, no token symbols, no hook names anywhere in this file
meta.f2HandCheck: F2 hand-check 2026-10-06: 3 sample books checked raw initFee vs raw feeWavg straight from the fixture before any headline shipped; verdict: the divergence is measured, not definitional — 257 of 276 PAYS-LPS books disagree, 19 agree exactly
